name: Backend Developer
description: Architect scalable backend services, REST/gRPC/GraphQL APIs, relational and NoSQL databases, caching layers, and asynchronous task workers.

levels.title: API Protocols & Backend Architecture
levels.description: REST principles, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, gRPC Protocol Buffers, and GraphQL schemas.

topics.title: gRPC & Protocol Buffers
topics.description: Binary serialization, HTTP/2 streaming, proto definitions, and high-performance RPCs.

levels.title: Databases & Caching (PostgreSQL + Redis)
levels.description: ACID guarantees, transaction isolation levels, indexing (B-Tree, GIN), and Redis caching patterns.

topics.title: Redis Caching Patterns & Distributed Locks
topics.description: Cache-Aside, Write-Through, cache stampede prevention, TTL strategies, and Redlock distributed locking.
